section.p: A single task topic contains instructions for both Windows and Linux users:<step platform="windows"> <cmd>Open <uicontrol>Control Panel</uicontrol> and select <uicontrol>Programs and Features</uicontrol>.</cmd></step> <step platform="linux"><cmd>Open a terminal and run <codeph>sudo apt install appname</codeph>.</cmd></step>
When publishing the Windows guide, the publishing system includes only Windows-specific content. The Linux guide receives only Linux content. Both outputs come from the same source.
